[Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) has scanned for vulnerabilities in the public-facing servers of their targets.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)
[Winter Vivern](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1035) has used remotely-hosted instances of the Acunetix vulnerability scanner.(Citation: SentinelOne WinterVivern 2023)
[VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has scanned victim environments for susceptibility to vulnerability exploitation.(Citation: DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026)
APT41 used tools and frameworks to brute-force directories on web servers.
Volatile Cedar used DirBuster and GoBuster to enumerate web directories and DNS subdomains.
MoustachedBouncer injected malicious content into DNS, HTTP, and SMB replies to redirect victims to a fake update page.
Disco injected content into DNS, HTTP, and SMB replies to redirect targeted hosts toward malicious file downloads.
